scenes.line1: How do you safely patch Linux?
scenes.say: How do you safely patch Linux systems? What does the daily routine look like?

scenes.label: Patching
scenes.sub: Half of infra ops is patching. It's daily work.
scenes.say: Patching is half of infrastructure operations. It's daily work in most infra roles.
Red Hat uses D-N-F or yum. Ubuntu uses apt. Know which tool fits your distro.
Always patch non-production first. Then, patch production in waves during a change window to minimize risk.

scenes.title: RHEL vs Ubuntu
scenes.say: On Red Hat, run dnf update. On Ubuntu, use apt update and apt upgrade. Check if a reboot is needed after patching.

scenes.question: Can you skip 'apt update' before 'upgrade'?
scenes.right: No. 'apt update' refreshes the package list. You need both.
scenes.say: Can you skip apt update before upgrade? No. Apt update refreshes the package list. You need both steps.
